unit_note: USD millions. Borrowing from the US Treasury under Treasury and Veterans Affairs. Blank and less-than-500k (**) cells omitted. Ships 6 relations (1 monthly + 5 fiscal-year) against a sizing floor of 8 and remains under it: 3 of 8 rows print account balances with no transaction cell in either the This-Month or the Fiscal-Year-to-Date column, so neither roll-forward identity is computable there. Adjudicated 2026-08-18 against p27 - the floor was optimistic at sizing; nothing padded and no cell invented.
